GOLDENGLOW_RELIC_INSULATING_COMB.title: Insulating Comb
GOLDENGLOW_RELIC_INSULATING_COMB.descrip: At the start of combat, [gold]Channel[/gold] 1 [gold]Buoy[/gold] onto a random enemy.
GOLDENGLOW_RELIC_INSULATING_COMB.flavor: Actually, it's still easy to shock the customers. Better keep a few spares!
GOLDENGLOW_RELIC_WIND_CHIME.title: Wind Chime
GOLDENGLOW_RELIC_WIND_CHIME.flavor: A decoration for Miss Kazemaru. When the wind blows it tinkles, always carrying your thoughts far away on the breeze.
GOLDENGLOW_RELIC_HAIR_CAPE.title: Hair Cape
GOLDENGLOW_RELIC_HAIR_CAPE.flavor: Hair shows a person's spirit, so it must be well tended!
GOLDENGLOW_RELIC_TECHNIQUE_NOTES.title: Technique Notes
GOLDENGLOW_RELIC_TECHNIQUE_NOTES.descrip: At the start of your turn, [gold]Pulse[/gold] once.
GOLDENGLOW_RELIC_TECHNIQUE_NOTES.flavor: Lately I've spent two hours a day reviewing techniques and theory. I'll definitely get a good grade!
GOLDENGLOW_RELIC_COLOR_SWATCH.title: Color Swatch
GOLDENGLOW_RELIC_COLOR_SWATCH.descriptio: At the start of combat, gain 1 random [gold]Exhaust[/gold] card.
GOLDENGLOW_RELIC_COLOR_SWATCH.flavor: I've memorized the hair color of most Rhodes Island operators!
GOLDENGLOW_RELIC_INSULATING_SCISSORS.des: At the start of combat, all characters [gold]Channel[/gold] 1 [gold]Buoy[/gold]. [gold]Buoy[/gold] effectiveness increases by [blue]1[/blue].
GOLDENGLOW_RELIC_INSULATING_SCISSORS.fla: Absolutely won't shock the customers! But they say the slight tingle energizes them. What a headache...
GOLDENGLOW_RELIC_CLEANING_TOOLS.title: Cleaning Tools
GOLDENGLOW_RELIC_CLEANING_TOOLS.flavor: Since adding the bar business, we've had to keep several sets of cleaning tools on hand.
GOLDENGLOW_RELIC_FLORAL_TONER.title: Floral Toner
GOLDENGLOW_RELIC_FLORAL_TONER.descriptio: Whenever you [gold]Attract[/gold] a card, deal [blue]1[/blue] damage to a random enemy.
GOLDENGLOW_RELIC_FLORAL_TONER.flavor: Skincare from Miss Lena for "Green Spark". Pat it gently on your face and you'll smell spring.
GOLDENGLOW_RELIC_NIGHT_SKY_PROJECTOR.des: Add 1 additional [gold]Exhaust[/gold] card to combat rewards.
GOLDENGLOW_RELIC_NIGHT_SKY_PROJECTOR.fla: It shows the beautiful wild night sky that Sister Quercus spoke of.
